game: Kawa no Nushi Tsuri 2 / 川のぬし釣り2 (SFC/SNES, 1995)
scope: Custom-fly maker at the rear NPC in the first-stage (early stream) tackle shop. This records only what was directly observed there; it does not claim later shops have the same or fewer choices.

capture_provenance.rom: User-supplied Japanese SFC ROM, 1-Kawa-no-Nushi-Tsuri-2-Japan-.sfc; unpatched original used for these captures.
capture_provenance.capture_method: Direct 256x224 screenshots from an isolated Snes9x Libretro runtime, using a copied shop-entry save state. The PNGs preserve the rendered game screen; no AI artwork or menu redraws were used.
capture_provenance.notes: The NPC is the person behind the main shop counter. Walking into the NPC starts the interaction; A advances dialogue and confirms the default yes choice.

observed_process.action: Walk into the rear shop NPC to start the custom-fly interaction.
observed_process.screen_text_ja: いらっしゃいませ！どの毛バリを作りますか？
observed_process.confidence: directly observed in original SFC runtime

observed_process.action: Choose a fly family. The first-stage shop's chooser visibly lists three entries.
observed_process.availability_limit: Only the first-stage shop was checked. This is not evidence that additional families are unavailable from later shops.

observed_process.action: Choose a body sprite from the Body palette for the selected family.
observed_process.notes: These are counts of sprites visible in the captured first-stage palettes, not totals for every ROM record or later shop. The current selection label shown below the Mayfly and Caddis palettes is ウェット; the Terrestrial capture shows アント.

palette_count_status.メイフライ: 15 selectable body IDs independently controller-verified; data/fly-maker-menu-positions.json
palette_count_status.カディス: historical visible-sprite estimate; selectable count not controller-verified
palette_count_status.テレストリアル: historical visible-sprite estimate; selectable count not controller-verified

observed_process.action: Choose a wing sprite using the verified Area 1 Mayfly row/column crosswalk.
observed_process.scope: Controller-only position checks from the documented Area 1 Mayfly menu state; does not prove other menu contexts or fishing performance.

superseded_visual_observation.notes: The captured Mayfly sequence shows 20 choices in a 5-by-4 palette. The final two visible icons are gray and pale yellow at row 5, columns 3 and 4. Their correspondence to the final special wing records (66/67) is based on the decoded ROM component ordering; the UI itself does not display internal IDs.

observed_process.action: Choose a tail sprite, or choose 無し (none).
observed_process.notes: This was observed in the same first-stage Mayfly sequence: nine tail sprites across four rows, plus a separate 無し (none) option.
observed_process.controller_verification: Nine nonzero tail IDs and None (stored00) independently matched; data/fly-maker-menu-positions.json

observed_process.action: Review the quoted cost and confirm the order.
observed_process.example_combination: Default first body + first wing + first tail in the Mayfly sequence
observed_process.screen_text_ja: 25円いただきますが、よろしいですか？
observed_process.price_limit: 25 yen is confirmed for this one selected combination only; other combinations were not price-tested.

observed_process.action: Select はい to create the fly.
observed_process.result: Money on the status panel changed from 100 to 75; the NPC then displayed a thank-you message and asked ほかにございますか?

stat_caveat.customizer_screen: The captured creation screens display component sprites, a fly-type label, and the quoted yen price. They do not show a numeric fishing-stat panel.
stat_caveat.do_not_infer: Do not conclude that component stats or behavior differences are absent just because this UI has no numeric stat display. ROM-level fishing-preference analysis is a separate evidence source.

sources.title: SFC 釣魚太郎2 - 溪流 (初始劇情、村莊設施)
sources.type: Player walkthrough with original SFC screenshots
sources.relevant_detail: The author says some tackle shops have an NPC in the back who can customize flies. Existing screenshot asset references/items-images/walkthrough-fly-customization.jpg shows the family/body menu but not later component screens.

sources.title: Original SFC instruction manual, fly section (printed page 23)
sources.type: Photographs of the original Japanese manual
sources.relevant_detail: Explains equipped-fly selection and the manual's broader fly taxonomy, including families and Wet/Dry types. It does not document the custom-fly maker's full screen sequence.

sources.title: 川のぬし釣り2全魚種RTA part 2/3 (player Q&A)
sources.relevant_detail: The creator says two flies with the same name, メイフライウェット, can perform differently. This supports keeping numeric/stat conclusions separate from the customizer's display.

evidence_status: Historical capture log. Current menu-position evidence is maintained in the linked controller-verified crosswalks. Visual sprite counts alone do not prove selectable counts.
